description: Na₄Mg(SiSe₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-13°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.04 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-13°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.13 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.07 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-8°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.15 Å. Mg is bonded to six Se atoms to form MgSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra and edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-8°. There are a spread of Mg-Se bond distances ranging from 2.77-2.82 Å. Si is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There are a spread of Si-Se bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.30 Å. There are three inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Mg, and one Si atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄MgSi octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-89°. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Mg, and one Si atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄MgSi octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-89°. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Mg, and one Si atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄MgSi octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-88°.
